## Code and formatting in cells

| Call | Does | Returns |
|---|---|---|
| `fork()` | **Clones** the process; see [the manual](https://example.com) | **0** in the child, the PID in the parent |
| `execlp(prog, argv0, arg1, ..., NULL)` | Replaces the program, *keeping* the PID | Only on failure: `-1` |
| `wait(NULL)` | Waits for a child | PID or `-1` LAST-CELL-OF-CODE-TABLE |

The last paragraph of the book. TABLES-BOOK-END
